prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet & Name Your Desktop Companion", "Pick a companion and customize their personality traits before bringing them to your desktop.", "Select Companion", "Pet Name"]
1: ["Signing in secures your companion's memory, items, and settings across reinstalls."]
2: ["Your Companion is Active on Desktop", "Your pet is now living on your screen. Use your top-bar shortcut or right-click anytime to call or dismiss them.", "Start Exploring"]
3: ["Waking Up Your Desktop Pet", "We are calibrating animations and preparing screen boundaries for your new friend."]
4: ["Upload Pet Photo for Custom 3D Model", "We check background clarity and lighting automatically to ensure high model quality.", "Choose clear front-facing photo", "Model preview"]
5: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Scroll through pet personalities and choose the companion style that fits your workflow."]
6: ["Feel free to minimize. You will receive a desktop notification when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Quick Controls for Your New Pet", "Double-click your pet to open interaction menu. Press Alt+P to toggle visibility at any time.", "Essential Shortcuts", "Try First Interaction"]
8: ["Cloud Pet Saver: Protects your pet memory & customization"]
9: ["A Tiny Friend on Your Desktop", "Discover a loyal digital companion that lives right alongside your everyday work and play."]
